description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/latlon3d/rules/varcoeff_laplacian_lev_robin_surface_bc -- the variable-coefficient vertical diffusion operator with a ROBIN SURFACE-EXCHANGE ground (dry deposition out, prescribed emission in) and a zero-flux model top. Shares the interior and model-top slabs with the no-flux sibling and differs ONLY at k = 1, so diffing this golden against latlon3d_varcoeff_laplacian_lev_noflux_bc isolates exactly the surface closure. Pins the RESISTANCE-IN-SERIES ground flux (vdep*u[1] - emis) * 2 kz[1] / (2 kz[1] + vdep*dz[1]) and the reads of the two surface free names vdep and emis. NLEV = 6.
